answers.1: A man's head and upper neck, seen from the side (right profile), hair shaved above and behind the ear; panel 4 is a close-up circle (magnifying glass) over the area just behind/above the ear.

answers.4: A worried patient might read panel 3 as an open wound or a new cut appearing after removing the bandage, or think the yellow strip is something stuck in the skin.

Whether the strip should be left or removed is not shown.
